D: Bond's loyalty to M is tested when her past comes back to haunt MI6.
P: Serve the mains when Bond and M reach the old family lodge in the Scottish highlands.
S: Steamed pork and prawn dumplings with ginger and shiitake
Pork and prawn siu mai: mince, chopped prawn, ginger, shiitake and soy wrapped in open wonton skins, steamed 8 minutes, a dot of roe on top.
the glass tower fight in Shanghai

Fluffy steamed bao stuffed with sticky soy-braised pork belly, quick pickled cucumber, crushed salted peanuts, coriander and a swipe of hoisin. Simmer 800g pork belly, cut into 2cm slices, with 80ml soy, 60ml Shaoxing wine, 3 tbsp brown sugar, sliced ginger and 500ml water for 2 hours until sticky, reducing at the end. Slice a cucumber thin and toss with 2 tbsp rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar for 20 minutes. Steam 12 frozen bao buns for 8 minutes. Fill with hoisin, pork, cucumber, crushed peanuts and coriander.
Crisp oatcakes topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill
Oatcakes of oats, butter and salt baked at 180C for 20 minutes, topped with crème fraîche, Scottish smoked salmon and dill.
M: Juniper rubbed venison backstrap in whisky redcurrant sauce, with mash
Venison backstrap rubbed with juniper, thyme and pepper, seared to rare, rested, with a whisky and redcurrant sauce, mashed neeps and roast potatoes.
a cold night in the lodge before Silva arrives

Smoked haddock poached in milk and flaked into a thick, creamy potato and leek soup, finished with chives, black pepper and buttered crusty bread. Poach 500g smoked haddock or cod in 750ml milk with a bay leaf for 5 minutes, then lift out and flake, keeping the milk. Soften 2 sliced leeks in 40g butter, add 600g diced potatoes and 400ml water and simmer 15 minutes. Add the milk, mash about half the potatoes to thicken, then add the fish and 100ml cream. Warm through and finish with chives and pepper. Serve with buttered bread.
W: Whipped honey whisky cream layered with raspberries and toasted oats
Oats toasted in a dry pan until nutty, folded through cream whipped with honey and a splash of whisky, layered in glasses with raspberries crushed lightly, more oats on top.
K: Scotch, lemon, honey and ginger syrup shaken and served over ice

Blended Scotch shaken with fresh lemon and honey ginger syrup, poured over a big cube and floated with a little smoky single malt. Simmer 60g honey, 60ml water and a sliced 4cm piece of ginger for 5 minutes and cool. For each drink, shake 50ml blended Scotch, 20ml lemon juice and 20ml honey ginger syrup with ice. Strain over a large ice cube in a tumbler and gently float 10ml peated single malt on top. Garnish with a piece of candied ginger.

s.note: Steamed pork and prawn dumplings with ginger and shiitake
s.how: Mix 300g pork mince, 150g chopped prawns, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 3 chopped shiitake and 1 tbsp soy. Spoon into 24 wonton wrappers, pinch up the sides and steam 8 minutes. Top each with a dot of roe.

s.note: Crisp oatcakes topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill
s.how: Mix 200g oats with 50g melted butter, salt and a splash of hot water. Press thin, cut rounds and bake at 180C for 20 minutes. Top with crème fraîche, 150g smoked salmon, dill and lemon.

m.note: Juniper rubbed venison backstrap in whisky redcurrant sauce, with mash
m.how: Rub 800g venison backstrap with crushed juniper, thyme and pepper. Sear to rare and rest. Add 60ml whisky, 2 tbsp redcurrant jelly and 150ml stock to the pan and reduce. Mash 600g swede with butter. Roast 800g potatoes.
